messages.subject: Campus Drive: Tidewater Logistics - Junior Analyst (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Tidewater Logistics is hiring Junior Analysts (CTC 7.5 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT | CGPA 8.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/tidewaterJA by 11:59 PM, 20 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Tidewater Logistics - Junior Analyst (2026 Batch)
messages.body: Correction: the GPA cutoff for the Tidewater Logistics drive has been lowered to CGPA 7.0 and above. All other criteria unchanged.
